item_name: Rothco Tri-Color Desert SWAT Cloth BDU Pants
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tri-Color Desert SWAT Cloth BDU Pants are designed for durability, comfort, and versatility. Made from a tough TC rip-stop fabric, these pants are built to withstand rugged outdoor conditions, making them ideal for work or tactical use. The adjustable waist ensures a custom fit, while reinforced seat and knees provide extra durability in high-wear areas. Multiple utility pockets offer convenient storage for tools, gear, or personal items, making these BDU pants practical for any activity.
